detail.command:
git status --short && printf '
=== SOURCE TREE ===
' && find src -maxdepth 4 -type f -print | sort && printf '
=== COURSE LEVEL BUILDER FILES ===
' && find src -type f \( -iname '*course*' -o -iname '*level*' -o -iname '*builder*' \) -print | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,260p' "$f"; done
